Fischer colour-codes its standard SX nylon plug range by diameter, making on-site identification fast. The table below reflects the SX series — the most widely distributed Fischer plug family in UAE builders' merchants and e-commerce platforms as of 2026.

Red  | 6 mm  | 6 mm  | M4–M5 / No.8–10  | Curtain tracks, cabinet fixings, light shelves  | ~0.8 kN

*Pull-out values are indicative based on Fischer SX series technical datasheet for C20/25 concrete, solid substrate, minimum embedment depth. Always verify against project-specific geotechnical and structural data. [Source: Fischer SX Technical Datasheet, fischer-international.com]

### Fischer SX vs UX Plug Series: Key Differences

The SX series features a ribbed shaft and collar stop for universal use across solid and hollow masonry — the standard choice for most UAE site work. The UX series is a universal plug optimised for use in hollow substrates like hollow block and lightweight partition walls: its longer, more flexible wings fold and anchor effectively in cavities where the SX would fail. On UAE projects using hollow cement block partitions (common in older villa stock in Sharjah and Ajman), specifying UX or a dedicated cavity anchor rather than SX is the correct call.

### Brown, Red, Grey, Yellow — Decoding Fischer Colour Codes

The colour refers strictly to the plug's diameter, not its material grade or load class. A red plug is always 6 mm regardless of plug length. When ordering, always specify both colour (diameter) and length — a 6×30 mm and a 6×50 mm are both red but suit different embedment depths and wall thicknesses.

We are pleased to see that the VS Code Marketplace offers many more such community-provided extensions, all of which help identify matching bracket pairs in very creative ways, including: Rainbow Brackets, Subtle Match Brackets, Bracket Highlighter, Blockman, and Bracket Lens. This variety of extensions shows that there is a real desire by VS Code users to get better support for brackets.

### The performance problem

Unfortunately, the non-incremental nature of the Decoration API and missing access to VS Code's token information causes the Bracket Pair Colorizer extension to be slow on large files: when inserting a single bracket at the beginning of the checker.ts file of the TypeScript project, which has more than 42k lines of code, it takes about 10 seconds until the colors of all bracket pairs update. This limit cannot be overcome. In particular, bracket pair colors should not be requested asynchronously as soon as they appear in the viewport, as this would have caused visible flickering when scrolling through large files. A discussion of this can be found in issue #128465.

### What we did

Instead, in the 1.60 update, we reimplemented the extension in the core of VS Code and brought this time down to less than a millisecond - in this particular example, that is more than 10,000 times faster.

The feature can be enabled by adding the setting `"editor.bracketPairColorization.enabled": true`.

Now, updates are no longer noticeable, even for files with hundreds of thousands of bracket pairs. Notice how the bracket-color in line 42,788 reflects the new nesting level immediately after typing `{` in line 2:

Image: A video of VS Code showing that the native implementation needs less than a millisecond to process the text change in checker.ts

Once we decided we move it into core, we also took the opportunity to look into how to make it as fast as we can. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

steps.text:
This is a VS Code 1.71.0 regression, not a C++ extension issue. Update to a newer VS Code release (or temporarily set the option back to `false`); the current editor still supports this setting.

Use:

```json
"editor.bracketPairColorization.enabled": true,
"editor.bracketPairColorization.independentColorPoolPerBracketType": true
```

If it persists after updating, test with the default Dark+ theme: custom themes must define `editorBracketHighlight.foreground1` through `foreground6`, otherwise the color pool can appear as one color.
